title: The Cech differential vanishes on repeated alternating tuples
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], I any type, U : I → Opens(X) a family of opens [def-sc-zariski-site], F : Opens(X)^op → Ab a presheaf of abelian groups, and S the chosen finite-intersection Čech complex [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex]. Let p ≥ 0 and let c be a degree-p full Čech cochain. Assume for every tuple t : Fin(p+1) → I and permutation σ of Fin(p+1) that c(t) = sign(σ) F(S.indexMap(t,σ)^op)(c(t ∘ σ)). Assume also c(t) = 0 whenever t is not injective. Then d_p(c)(t) = 0 for every noninjective tuple t : Fin(p+2) → I.

source.place: Section 20.23, Tag 01FG: verification omitted immediately before Definition 01FH; signed extension preceding Lemma 01FJ

proof.text: choose positions a < b with equal entries. Every face deleting a position other than a or b still has these equal entries, so its value is zero by hz. If the face deleting a also has a repetition, then so does the face deleting b, since they differ by a permutation; both remaining terms vanish. Otherwise the two faces differ by the cycle moving the surviving equal entry past b-a-1 positions. Its sign is (-1)^(b-a-1). Apply hc to that cycle. The face signs (-1)^a and (-1)^b make the two surviving coefficients opposite. Both restriction composites agree in the poset of opens, so the terms cancel. This works with arbitrary abelian groups, including groups with 2-torsion, without deducing vanishing merely from antisymmetry. For p = 0 the two faces agree and have coefficients 1 and -1; an empty index type has no such tuple.

theorem cechDifferential_repeated (X : Scheme.{u}) {I : Type v}
    (U : I → X.Opens) (F : X.Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{w})
    (S : SiteCechComplex U (fun i ↦ homOfLE (le_top : U i ≤ ⊤)))
    (p : ℕ) (c : S.cochains F p)
    (hc : ∀ (t : Fin (p + 1) → I) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (p + 1))),
      c t = (Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) • F.map (S.indexMap t σ).op (c (t ∘ σ)))
    (hz : ∀ t : Fin (p + 1) → I, ¬ Function.Injective t → c t = 0)
    (t : Fin (p + 2) → I) (ht : ¬ Function.Injective t) :
    S.differentialValue F p c t = 0
